fusions.name: Last Thread
fusions.desc: Strikes an enemy at or below 25% health from up to 6 tiles away for 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and slows it by 20% for 3 seconds. Its damage rises 10% for each affliction already on the target (max 40%).

fusions.name: Fraying Strands
fusions.desc: Looses 4 strands of locusts at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage with a 40% chance to leave the target [Exposed] for 6 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Drapery of Wings
fusions.desc: For 9 seconds, each debuff laid on you has a 60% chance to be sent back to its source instead.

fusions.name: Moulted Lining
fusions.desc: When you are hurt by anything but fire, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
